title: Woman killed in overnight shooting near 79th, Wornall Road
text: KANSAS CITY, Mo. — One woman is dead following an overnight shooting Sunday outside a Kansas City gas station. Kansas City police officers responded to the area of West 79th Street and Wornall Road, just before 1:30 a.m. When officers arrived on scene they were directed to the parking lot of a convenience store where they located a woman suffering from a gunshot wound. She was pronounced dead at the scene. The shooting is being investigated as a homicide and no suspects are in custody at this time, according to police.
